answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 1531 Country: India Title: Consuming things which contain tobacco is haram or not? Question: Consuming things which contain tobacco is haram or not? Answer ID: 1531 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 501=498=M) It is allowed but undesirable to use tobacco without a reason. Therefore, it is better to avoid consuming any thing that contains tobacco. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
